title: Distribution Channel Map
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Entrepreneurship
description: An interactive Chart.js scatter plot that places eight distribution channels by relative cost and reach, shades a best-fit zone for early-stage, low-capital ventures, and lets learners inspect each channel and compare any two side by side with a tradeoff verdict.

educational.topic: Distribution channel selection by cost, reach, and fit
learningObjectives: Compare distribution channels by plotting channel cost against channel reach
Analyze the cost-versus-reach tradeoff to judge which channels best fit an early-stage venture with limited resources

controls.label: Channel points
controls.purpose: Hover for the definition and cost/reach values; click or tap to select a channel and fill the detail panel

controls.label: Previous
controls.purpose: Select the next cheaper channel (also the left arrow key)

controls.label: Next
controls.purpose: Select the next more expensive channel (also the right arrow key)

controls.label: Compare with
controls.purpose: Mark a second channel and show a side-by-side cost, reach, and zone comparison with a tradeoff verdict

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Comparison and exploration tool: inspect each channel's position, then compare pairs on cost and reach
keyQuestions: Which channels give the widest reach for the least cost, and which are beaten on both axes by another channel?
Why do the widest-reaching channels sit outside the best-fit zone for a low-capital venture?
When should channel fit overrule the cost-versus-reach picture?
commonMisconceptions: The channel with the widest reach is always the best choice
The cheapest channel is always the best choice, regardless of where the customer pays attention
A new venture should launch on every channel at once
assessmentOpportunities: Explain why Marketplace sits outside the best-fit zone despite having the widest reach
State the cost and reach difference between any two channels and say which suits a low budget
Name a case where channel fit overrules the chart
